# Luau API reference

<!-- GENERATED by docsgen/gen_luau_api.py -->

Every type and function available to a Rive script, as the
compiler itself declares them. Signatures are Luau: `function
drawPath(self, path: Path, paint: Paint): ()` is called as
`renderer:drawPath(path, paint)`.

See [../protocols.md](../protocols.md) for how a script is
structured and attached to a scene.
